description: Add and remove deb822 formatted repositories in Debian based distributions.

parameters.name: allow_downgrade_to_insecure
parameters.description: Allow downgrading a package that was previously authenticated but is no longer authenticated. Choices: false true

parameters.name: allow_insecure
parameters.description: Allow insecure repositories. Choices: false true

parameters.name: allow_weak
parameters.description: Allow repositories signed with a key using a weak digest algorithm. Choices: false true

parameters.name: architectures
parameters.description: Architectures to search within repository.

parameters.name: by_hash
parameters.description: Controls if APT should try to acquire indexes via a URI constructed from a hashsum of the expected file instead of using the well-known stable filename of the index. Choices: false true

parameters.name: check_date
parameters.description: Controls if APT should consider the machine’s time correct and hence perform time related checks, such as verifying that a Release file is not from the future. Choices: false true

parameters.name: check_valid_until
parameters.description: Controls if APT should try to detect replay attacks. Choices: false true

parameters.name: components
parameters.description: Components specify different sections of one distribution version present in a Suite.

parameters.name: date_max_future
parameters.description: Controls how far from the future a repository may be.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Tells APT whether the source is enabled or not. Choices: false true

parameters.name: inrelease_path
parameters.description: Determines the path to the InRelease file, relative to the normal position of an InRelease file.

parameters.name: install_python_debian
parameters.description: Whether to automatically try to install the Python debian library or not, if it is not already installed. Without this library, the module does not work. - Runs apt install python3-debian. - Only works with the system Python. If you are using a Python on the remote that is not the system Python, set install_python_debian=false and ensure that the Python debian library for your Python version is installed some other way. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: languages
parameters.description: Defines which languages information such as translated package descriptions should be downloaded.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: The octal mode for newly created files in sources.list.d. Default: "0644"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the repo. Specifically used for X-Repolib-Name and in naming the repository and signing key files.

parameters.name: pdiffs
parameters.description: Controls if APT should try to use PDiffs to update old indexes instead of downloading the new indexes entirely. Choices: false true

parameters.name: signed_by
parameters.description: Either a URL to a GPG key, absolute path to a keyring file, one or more fingerprints of keys either in the trusted.gpg keyring or in the keyrings in the trusted.gpg.d/ directory, or an ASCII armored GPG public key block.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: A source string state. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default)

parameters.name: suites
parameters.description: Suite can specify an exact path in relation to the URI(s) provided, in which case the Components: must be omitted and suite must end with a slash (/). Alternatively, it may take the form of a distribution version (for example a version codename like disco or artful). If the suite does not specify a path, at least one component must be present.

parameters.name: targets
parameters.description: Defines which download targets apt will try to acquire from this source.

parameters.name: trusted
parameters.description: Decides if a source is considered trusted or if warnings should be raised before, for example packages are installed from this source. Choices: false true

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Which types of packages to look for from a given source; either binary deb or source code deb-src. Choices: "deb" ← (default) "deb-src" Default: ["deb"]

parameters.name: uris
parameters.description: The URIs must specify the base of the Debian distribution archive, from which APT finds the information it needs.

examples:
- name: Add debian repo
  deb822_repository:
    name: debian
    types: deb
    uris: http://deb.debian.org/debian
    suites: stretch
    components:
      - main
      - contrib
      - non-free

- name: Add debian repo with key
  deb822_repository:
    name: debian
    types: deb
    uris: https://deb.debian.org
    suites: stable
    components:

    signed_by: |-

    types: deb

    suites: '{{ ansible_distribution_release }}'
    components: stable
    architectures: amd64
    signed_by: https://download.example.com/linux/ubuntu/gpg

return_values.description: Path to the repository file Returned: always Sample: "/etc/apt/sources.list.d/focal-archive.sources"

return_values.name: key_filename
return_values.description: Path to the signed_by key file Returned: always Sample: "/etc/apt/keyrings/debian.gpg"
